title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Displaying Sales/Purchase Order No. in Item Ledger Entries (Source Order No. and Source Description)
summary: Business Central now provides Source Order No. and Source Description fields that allow users to display the original sales or purchase order numbers in Item Ledger Entries without custom development. These calculated fields can be added to the Item Ledger Entries page through personalization.
key_points: Source Order No. and Source Description (customer or vendor name) are calculated fields, not stored in the table, and show the sales or purchase order behind an item ledger entry
The existing Order Type, Order No. and Order Line No. fields cover only production, transfer, service and assembly orders, not sales or purchase orders
Add the fields to Item Ledger Entries through personalization, with no custom code needed
Reopen the page after adding the fields to see the values
Values come from the posted sales shipment or posted purchase receipt; if the order number is blank there, the field shows nothing

quotes.text: Microsoft recently introduced two new fields to address this exact issue, Source Order No. and Source Description
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the solution for displaying order numbers in Item Ledger Entries without custom development

quotes.text: These two fields are not actual physical fields stored in the table; rather, they are calculated via standard methods.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies how the fields work and why the page needs to be reopened to display data
